reset: synchronous active-low i_rstn; SRAM contents not reset; FIFO ownership is reset

parameters.BANK_DEPTH: 1..65535, exact half-Flit capacity per class is 2*BANK_DEPTH

input_contract: Two classes: lane0 Request, lane1 Response; each class producer supplies its own ordered prepared Control/tag words and Data/BE halves
Header admission is i_header_valid AND o_header_ready; tags are stored atomically with the header; Auth input waits for tags_valid
Data input count 0 idle, 1 or 2 offered halves, 3 invalid; o_data_ready means at least one half can be accepted, not that both were accepted
Advance data producer by o_data_accepted, which may be smaller than offered count; preserve unaccepted halves before any later data
i_headers/i_tags and data ordering must correspond within each class; no command formatter/splitter or transaction sequence validation is added here
Auth/done/shared/pending/credit/catch states come from the same port; Auth configuration remains stable for reset epoch
Only actual wire o_tx_taken drives i_taken and FIFO output consumption; accepted input is distinct from sent output
All storage and port resets must share the same epoch; coordinated reset drops buffered local transactions
Data offer count and available data eventually supply ordered remaining halves; permanent producer starvation is not hidden as protocol progress
capacity: Header word 512 bits contains one 256-bit Control plus 256-bit tags
Two 256-bit striped banks per class support two-half throughput without dual-read emulation
All cached and in-flight reads remain counted; no borrowing same-edge released space
Header FIFO and each data bank use the existing registered SDP controller; min-depth case does not increase declared capacity
open: UPLI conversion and capacity-aware oversized transaction completion
Data Poison and remaining TL messages
Complete arbitrary-traffic liveness and reference/resource induction
Process STA, actual SRAM/PHY signoff and full dual-IP integration
